items.item: A breadcrumb shows the path back to the customer list and includes the customer's name
items.evidence: nav[aria-label=Breadcrumb] ol: Bán hàng / Khách hàng / Công ty TNHH Thương mại và Dịch vụ Minh Phát; visible in screenshot.

items.item: The record header shows name and ID, a status badge with text, at most four key fields and exactly one primary action
items.evidence: h1 name, 'KH-00128', badge 'Đang hoạt động'; dl of 4 key fields (Người phụ trách, Hạng, Doanh thu 12 tháng, Công nợ); one blue primary 'Sửa khách hàng' (BP) plus icon-only overflow; audit headerPrimaryActions=1.

items.item: Secondary actions are grouped in an overflow menu
items.evidence: Button data-action=menu-record aria-haspopup=menu aria-label 'Thao tác khác cho ...' opens openMenu with archive/restore etc.

items.item: Content is organised in sections or tabs, not a long stack of unrelated cards
items.evidence: role=tablist: Tổng quan / Người liên hệ / Đơn hàng / Hoạt động; overview uses <section> with h2 headings separated by border-t rules, not cards.

items.item: The activity history is a timeline with absolute timestamps (relative times only with the absolute value available)
items.evidence: actItem renders <ol> with icon per type, actor, text, change diffs, and fmtDT(a.at) '04/11/2026 15:58 · 32 phút trước' (absolute always shown, relative secondary). Note: no connecting vertical line, just divided list with icon dots.

items.item: The recent orders table right-aligns amounts and formats currency
items.evidence: ordersHead/orderRow: total cell 'text-right tnum' with nf.format (vi-VN grouping), column header 'Tổng tiền (VND)' right-aligned; audit numericCells misaligned=0. Currency is shown as grouped number with VND in header rather than a symbol per cell.

items.item: Sections without data show an empty state with a next step
items.evidence: emptyBlock used for orders ('Chưa có đơn hàng nào' + 'Tạo đơn hàng'), contacts ('Thêm người liên hệ'), activity ('Thêm ghi chú'); reachable via demo empty mode. Overview recent-activity empty has no action button (minor).

items.item: Avatars appear only for people; the company is shown with its logo or no image
items.evidence: Company header has no image. Initials avatars appear only in the contacts table (contactRow, people) and the user account button 'HN'; the 'V' sidebar mark is the product logo.

notes: Clean, restrained UI: no gradients, glass, emoji, greeting header, KPI icon tiles, decorative charts, promo card, hover-lift, or card-in-card. Radii 4/6px, slate-neutral sidebar with blue-700 only for primary and links. Section labels are small sentence-case, not tracked uppercase. Audit score 96 (only table-above-fold warn, which is a list-page rule and not applicable to a detail page). Minor: overview orders table is below the fold (973px); the 5-column timeline lacks a connector line. Only the first 607 of 900 source lines were read plus the menu handlers; the full-page PNG was not opened.
